name: developer-device-platform-device-run
description: Runs automated, non-interactive jobs on remote Android devices with Developer Device Platform (DDP) Device Run using `gcloud beta device-run sessions`: native Android executables or shell scripts (for example CLI tools, custom runners, test harnesses or benchmarks) and Android instrumentation tests, on one or many devices, then waits for completion and collects per-device outputs and logs. Use when running a binary or test suite on remote devices without an interactive connection. Don't use it for interactive device reservations, adb tunnels or screen streaming (use developer-device-platform-basics), or for local devices.
author: google
